T7-CD correct denial.input_reply: Claim reference {claim}: we reviewed the request and it was received on {received}, which is after the 30-day claim window in the agreement. The request is therefore denied.
T7-CD correct denial.input_condition: received timestamp genuinely outside the governing window for that claim
T7-CD correct denial.expected: stage DENIAL_REVIEW (or the product's equivalent explicit-review stop); the only offered action is accept-denial; no rebuttal, follow-up or new filing offered; no ledger amount changes; no automatic acceptance without a signed reviewer action

T7-AD ambiguous denial.input_reply: Regarding claim {claim}: we may be able to offer a partial goodwill credit if you agree to waive any further claims for this quarter; otherwise we are declining the request at this time.
T7-AD ambiguous denial.expected: no automatic acceptance, rebuttal or settlement; routed to required human review (unknown/ambiguous meaning); any model proposal is labelled a proposal; waiver is never accepted by the system; no amount recorded as awarded

T7-ME missing evidence.input_reply: For claim {claim}, please provide the request log showing the affected API calls during the outage window before we can evaluate it.
T7-ME missing evidence.expected: stage NEEDS_EVIDENCE (or equivalent); cure only with an existing signed evidence record; if none exists the case stays pending; no artifact invented by the system or a model; deadline shown from the governing source

T7-DS duplicate submission.input: repeat the same approval/submission action, and redeliver one signed vendor event with a fresh signature
T7-DS duplicate submission.expected: exactly one outbound receipt/filing; second action returns the same state or a refusal; redelivery leaves state identical; an exact replay of signed headers is refused

T7-RS restart.input: stop the served process (SIGKILL) mid-workflow after at least one recorded step, restart on the same data
T7-RS restart.expected: state identical to pre-kill; resumable; no duplicated step, receipt or ledger entry; final ledger unchanged versus an uninterrupted run

T7-TO timeout.input: model job whose provider exceeds its bound (controlled fake executable in an isolated workspace; labelled controlled provider)
T7-TO timeout.expected: job ends terminal UNCERTAIN/timeout with the reason recorded; no retry; no state advance or financial effect; UI shows the timeout, not a spinner forever

T7-FO foreign object.expected: refused (4xx) or not linkable; Northwind agreement never attached to the DocuSign bill; no cross-tenant read or write
